label: Warm & Mysterious

request.voice_description: A young American man in his early twenties with a warm, slightly raspy voice and a mid-range pitch. He tells mystery stories for YouTube Shorts in an intimate, hushed but clear way, with controlled suspense: he slows down on key words, leans into them, and lets the tension hang in short pauses. Natural and conversational, never theatrical. Clear articulation, neutral General American accent. Not deep, not a documentary narrator, not monotone or robotic. Studio-quality recording.
request.text: On December 4th, 1872, the crew of the ship Dei Gratia spotted a vessel near the Azores. It was the Mary Celeste. But now, all ten were gone. And the strangest part? The ship was still seaworthy.
